name: Can decorative millwork be painted or stained?

mainEntity.name: Can decorative millwork be painted or stained?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, decorative millwork can be both painted and stained, depending on the material and desired aesthetic. Solid wood is versatile and can be stained to highlight its natural grain or painted for a consistent, crisp look. MDF and polyurethane millwork are typically painted due to their smooth surfaces and composition. A decision factor here is the material chosen initially; if you envision a stained finish, selecting a high-quality solid wood is essential. Painted millwork, however, offers broader color flexibility and can easily be updated in the future.
acceptedAnswer.description: Millwork can be painted or stained. Solid wood is good for staining, while MDF and polyurethane are best for painting.
